columns.name: AGGR_ID
columns.description: Autogenerated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: RESPONSE_TIME_P99
columns.description: The 99th percentile of the response time for the given metric level.

columns.name: RESPONSE_TIME_P50
columns.description: The 50th percentile of the response time for the given metric level.

columns.name: MEDIAN_CORRECTNESS
columns.description: The median correctness for the given metric level.

columns.name: ERROR_RATE
columns.description: The error rate for the given metric level.

columns.name: ERROR_COUNT
columns.description: The error count for the given metric level.

columns.name: INPUT_TOKENS_COUNT
columns.description: The total count of Input tokens for the given metric level.

columns.name: OUTPUT_TOKENS_COUNT
columns.description: The total count of output tokens for the given metric level.

columns.name: JOBS_COUNT
columns.description: The number of jobs for the given metric level.

columns.name: SESSIONS_COUNT
columns.description: The number of sessions for the given metric level.

columns.name: METRIC_LEVEL
columns.description: The metric level such as SESSION, WORKFLOW, SYSTEM.

columns.name: TARGET_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: The code of the target object that aggregation metrics are for.

columns.name: AGGREGATION_RANGE
columns.description: The time range for which the metric is being aggregated for, such as 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M.

columns.name: GROUNDEDNESS
columns.description: Correctness of the evaluation run

columns.name: ANSWER_RELEVANCE
columns.description: Answer relevance of the evaluation run

columns.name: CONTEXT_RELEVANCE
columns.description: Context relevance of the evaluation run

columns.name: COVERAGE
columns.description: Stores the coverage metrics of the evaluation run

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
